verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README says the hosted treg.to instance is open for anyone to self-host. A community user reports self-hosting treg for development with one-click setup, and another commenter calls it open-source. First-party self-hosting documentation is limited to a single line. Missing for 10: a documented self-hosting/deployment guide, stated infrastructure requirements, and confirmation of feature parity with the hosted service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Built for the Superdesign team, live at [treg.to](https://treg.to) — anyone can self-host.
One user is self-hosting Treg for development and says it can be set up and run with one click on tarvis.io.
